_comment: Deployment-level branding for the generated report headers. Every CAA adopting this platform overrides this one file (and entity-logo.png next to it) instead of editing the .fodt templates. See README.md -> 'Report templates and entity branding'.
_comment_entityLogoPath: Image file next to this JSON, mounted into the Alfresco extension classpath. Any PNG or JPEG works; entityLogoMimeType is detected from the file when omitted.
_comment_docControlCodes: Optional document-control codes shown next to the 'Code' label in each report header. They were originally the authority's printed-form identifiers (for example IDAC's 'DVSO-CS-F04'); they are blank by default so an adopting authority can repurpose them, leave them empty, or ignore them entirely.
_comment_docControlVersion: Optional revision/version string shown next to the 'Version' label. Blank by default.
_comment_docControlDate: Optional date shown in the header (for example a form approval or revision date). Blank by default; the cell renders empty when unset.
_comment_signatures: Optional signatory identity for the plan/report body signature blocks. All values are blank by default; a request may supply approvedBy / approvedByPosition / signatureDate per inspection. The plan generation flow defaults approvedBy to the planner who defined the site visit, so this block is only a fallback.
_comment_signatureDate: Optional signature date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for the plan signature block. Blank by default; the generation date is used when unset.
